label: TP
reason: Both findings represent real vulnerabilities: XSS occurs because user input from cookies is concatenated directly into HTML output without any encoding/sanitization (lines 106-111), and insecure randomness is generated via java.util.Random.nextLong() (line 97) which produces predictable values suitable for authentication tokens.

evidence.note: User input from cookie values concatenated into HTML response without encoding
Insecure java.util.Random.nextLong() used for authentication token generation
